about: Every pair runs in pwsh 7 in its own scratch copy of the fixture (see scripts/run_lsd.py). bad replays the directory-listing miss: it throws the real miss line, or silently queries the wrong file. good runs the fixed query and prints the report it promises.

fixture.alias.py:
src = open('list.txt', encoding='utf-8').read()
assert 'lt' in src and 'lsd --tree' in src and 'alias' in src
print('alias PASS tree-alias')
fixture.cfg.py:
src = open('list.txt', encoding='utf-8').read()
assert '--config-file' in src and 'XDG_CONFIG_HOME' in src and '.config/lsd' in src
print('cfg PASS config-path')
fixture.git.py:
src = open('list.txt', encoding='utf-8').read()
assert '--git' in src and 'reduction' in src and 'recursively' in src
print('git PASS git-status')
fixture.icons.py:
src = open('list.txt', encoding='utf-8').read()
assert 'filetype' in src and 'name' in src and 'extension' in src
print('icons PASS icon-kinds')
fixture.iso.py:
src = open('list.txt', encoding='utf-8').read()
assert '--icon never' in src and '--ignore-config' in src and 'LS_COLORS' in src
print('iso PASS isolate-setup')
fixture.list.txt:
lsd is an LSDeluxe directory listing tool with colors and icons.
Shell aliases live in ~/.bashrc or ~/.zshrc: alias l='lsd -l' plus alias la plus alias lla plus alias lt='lsd --tree' for a tree view.
Icon overrides come in 3 kinds in icons.yaml: name plus filetype plus extension, e.g. filetype dir uses a folder glyph.
The --git flag shows git status; a directory status is a reduction of included file statuses computed recursively.
The --long flag shows extended file metadata as a table; --blocks names the blocks shown and their order including permission user group size date name inode git.
The --tree flag presents the listing as a tree; --depth stops it recursing past a given depth, and --recursive recurs into directories.
Sort with --timesort by time modified or --sizesort by size or --extensionsort by extension; --reverse flips any sort order; --sort takes size time version extension git; --no-sort keeps directory order.
Custom config via --config-file [YOUR_CUSTOM_PATH]; default Unix dir is $HOME/.config/lsd or $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/lsd, line 125 of the README.
Isolate setup with --icon never plus --ignore-config; custom colors ride on LS_COLORS; --icon defaults to auto on line 116; --icon-theme picks fancy or unicode; --classic disables colours or icons.
Line 77 documents --sizesort, line 80 documents --timesort, line 97 defines alias l as lsd -l, line 116 sets the --icon default auto, line 125 gives $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/lsd.
lsd-ls-miss
fixture.long.py:
src = open('list.txt', encoding='utf-8').read()
assert '--long' in src and 'table' in src and 'blocks' in src
print('long PASS long-table')
fixture.sort.py:
src = open('list.txt', encoding='utf-8').read()
assert 'timesort' in src and 'sizesort' in src and 'reverse' in src
print('sort PASS sort-order')
fixture.tree.py:
src = open('list.txt', encoding='utf-8').read()
assert '--tree' in src and '--depth' in src and 'recurs' in src
print('tree PASS tree-depth')

pairs.bad: throw 'used plain ls, missed lt with alias lsd --tree'
throw 'kept the default glyph, missed filetype with name extension'
throw 'listed with no status, missed --git with reduction recursively'
throw 'hid owners and dates, missed --long with table blocks'
throw 'flooded the deep tree, missed --tree with --depth recurs'
throw 'listed unsorted, missed timesort with sizesort reverse'
throw 'touched the default setup, missed --config-file with XDG_CONFIG_HOME .config/lsd'
throw 'kept broken glyphs, missed --icon never with --ignore-config LS_COLORS'
rg -n "icon" plain.txt; throw 'missed icon: plain.txt carries no icon phrase'
rg -n "sort" plain.txt; throw 'missed sort: plain.txt carries no sort phrase'
rg -n "alias" plain.txt; throw 'missed alias: plain.txt carries no alias phrase'
rg -n "XDG_CONFIG_HOME" plain.txt; throw 'missed XDG_CONFIG_HOME: plain.txt carries no config phrase'
